name: Onboarding cards
summary: Calm and light: a white card with a big soft shadow, and an accent button with a darker accent edge.

Fill: Card: flat white (the Layers card tone)
Button: accent, a touch lighter at the top (#4a9cf0 → #3b99f5)
Stroke: Card: a near-invisible 1px edge (#f8 on white)
Button: a ring in a darker accent (#5598d9 top, #3f81c4 bottom), lit slightly at the top
Effects: Card: a large soft drop shadow, deepest just under it (#dedede on a #f7f7f7 page)
Button: no shadow of its own
Not a lever: The calendar and notes illustrations are content

name: Aero buttons
summary: Windows 7 gloss: an accent-tinted gradient with a lighter top band and a cyan glow rising from the bottom, inside a double rim.

Fill: Linear accent gradient: light top (#cfddff), deeper middle band (#a3c1ff), lighter cyan bottom (#c4efff)
Sheen band: the top half lighter, ending at the middle
Radial glow from the bottom, shifted toward cyan
Stroke: Double rim: an outer ring in a darker accent (#8dace4) and an inner white rim
Effects: A soft accent-tinted shadow under it (#e1eaf2 on #f1f1f1)

name: Liquid glass toolbar
summary: Apple's 2025 glass: a barely-there frosted panel with a white rim, and more opaque pill buttons floating on it.

Fill: Panel: white at low opacity over a blurred backdrop (only #d7 over a #c3 background)
Pills: white at higher opacity (#eaeef1), slight top-to-bottom sheen
Stroke: Panel and pills: a bright white rim (#dde1e4 on the panel edge)
Effects: Pills: a soft drop shadow (#d3d7da under them)
Panel: a faint dark line just outside (#afb2b7)
Not a lever: The icons are accent glyphs with no effect

name: Green jelly toggle
summary: A glossy green pill sunk into a black track: tone-on-tone gradient, a darker green ring, and a bright catch-light along the bottom.

Fill: Pill: green gradient, light top (#acf4c3) to deeper bottom (#8aedaa)
Stroke: Pill: a ring in a darker green (#7fd29f)
Track: a lighter grey rim around the outside (#393939), then the black body: a double rim
Effects: Pill: a bright catch-light along the bottom inside edge (#c6fddb) and a soft highlight at the top
The whole control: a dark drop shadow on the #1f1f1f page
Not a lever: The glyph takes the darker green (#5eb476): ink, not material

name: Terminal tile
summary: A dark tile lit from the top right, with a bright rim and a recessed well holding an engraved prompt.

Fill: Tile: a diagonal gradient, lighter top right (#3f4044) to darker bottom (#1e1d23)
Stroke: Tile: a gradient rim, brightest at the top (#858489), dimmer at the sides (#646466) and bottom (#58585c)
Effects: Well: an inner shadow at the top and a faint catch-light at the bottom
Not a lever: Engraved glyph (a text effect: D13 keeps these opt-in)

name: Light tile with a bowl button
summary: A light tile with a strong top-to-bottom gradient, and a dark round button pressed into it like a bowl.

Fill: Tile: a strong gradient, #f2f2f2 top to #b5b9b9 bottom
Bowl: the reverse, black at the top (#161616) to grey at the bottom (#7b7b7b): a concave surface
Stroke: Bowl: a bright rim along the bottom edge (#d2d2d2 → #e7e8e9)
Effects: Bowl: a deep inner shadow at the top
Not a lever: The plus glyph's soft shadow (a glyph effect)

name: Car console
summary: Matte black plastic: a grainy housing, raised keys with a lit top edge and a shadow under them, a curved rocker, and a glowing LED.

Fill: Keys: a slight gradient, darker toward the bottom (#353537 → #2c2c2e)
Rocker: a fold near the top: a highlight band (#636364) above a dark crease, then flat (#303032)
Stroke: Keys and rocker: a lit top edge
Keys: a dark socket around each (the housing, darker): a tone ring
Effects: Keys: a dark contact shadow under each (#1d1d1f at the bottom edge)
LEDs: off is a grey pill with its own gradient; on is green with a small glow (#07d057)
Housing: a soft drop shadow on the light page

name: Frosted folder
summary: A grey glass folder front: what is behind it shows through blurred, with a lit top edge and a soft shadow.

Fill: Front: grey at partial opacity over the content behind, a little lighter at the bottom (#c8c8c8 → #d9d9d9)
Stroke: Front: a lit top edge along the tab
Effects: Front: frost (the logo behind it blurs)
Front: a darker lip along the bottom inside edge (an inner shadow: the glass has thickness)
A soft drop shadow under the folder (#ededed on white)
